root_cause.name: Password hash not updated in cache
root_cause.detail: The reset saved the new password in the database, but the auth service kept serving the old hash from cache.

solution.name: Clear auth cache
solution.steps: Delete the cached password hash for the user and ask them to reset the password one more time.

root_cause.name: Session token TTL too short
root_cause.detail: The login token expires after one minute, so the user is thrown out immediately.

solution.name: Increase session TTL
solution.steps: Set the session token lifetime to 30 minutes and restart the auth service.

root_cause.name: SMTP credentials expired
root_cause.detail: The email service can no longer log in to the mail server, so reset emails sit in the queue.

solution.name: Rotate SMTP password
solution.steps: Put the new mail password in the email service config and resend the queued reset emails.

root_cause.name: Missing idempotency key
root_cause.detail: A retry of the same checkout created a second charge because the gateway had nothing to detect the replay.

solution.name: Refund duplicate charge
solution.steps: Refund the second charge and save an idempotency key so the same order cannot be charged again.

root_cause.name: Payment SDK failed to load
root_cause.detail: The checkout page never loaded the card script, so the pay button does nothing.

solution.name: Reload payment SDK
solution.steps: Pin the payment script version and reload it on the checkout page.

root_cause.name: Bank webhook missing
root_cause.detail: The bank took the money, but the webhook that marks the order paid never reached us.

solution.name: Poll bank status
solution.steps: Ask the bank for the payment status and mark the order paid when the bank says success.

root_cause.name: Missing database index
root_cause.detail: The dashboard reads every order row for one user, which makes the page slow and the CPU high.

solution.name: Add orders index
solution.steps: Add an index on orders.user_id and cache the dashboard query for a few minutes.

root_cause.name: Full table scan on search
root_cause.detail: Search compares the typed name with every product row because there is no text index.

solution.name: Add search index
solution.steps: Add a full text index on product name and run the search against that index.

root_cause.name: Cache not invalidated
root_cause.detail: The payment updated the database, but the mobile app kept showing the old cached balance.

solution.name: Bump cache version
solution.steps: Increase the cache version when a payment event arrives so the app reads the new balance.

root_cause.name: Nightly ETL job failed
root_cause.detail: The export job stopped when it hit a null date, so yesterday's rows were never written.

solution.name: Rerun ETL job
solution.steps: Skip rows with a null date, fix them, and rerun the nightly export.
